description:
Use this when a research agent needs computed SEC fundamentals and parsed Form 4 insider trades, not raw reprints: the latest-quarter snapshot with margins, growth and the latest Form 4 (kind="intuitive", the default; stock_filings is a deprecated alias), multi-quarter history, TTM and recent Form 4s (kind="stats"), restatement-aware series, optional compare and 90-day net Form 4 activity (kind="pro"), or acceleration/deceleration signals in revenue, cash flow and margins plus Form 4 cluster-purchase and size-versus-holdings flags (kind="signals", feedable on new Form 4s). Pass symbol or omit to default to AAPL. SEC EDGAR only. Informational only, not investment advice, and not a buy, sell or hold. Example: get_stocks_data(kind="signals", symbol="NVDA"). Returns JSON in the `data` field with source attribution. Read-only; the only side effect is the payment you choose to make.
Kinds and prices:
- kind="intuitive": 10 sats or $0.01 USDC. Use this when an agent needs a company's latest fiscal-quarter snapshot with already-computed margins and growth, plus recent 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K links and the latest parsed Form 4 insider trade. Pass symbol or omit to default to AAPL. SEC EDGAR only. Informational only, not investment advice. MCP: get_stocks_data(kind="intuitive", symbol="NVDA").
- kind="stats": 50 sats or $0.05 USDC. Use this when an agent needs fiscal-quarter history with TTM and QoQ/YoY growth for revenue, cash flow and margins, plus a recent Form 4 insider-trade history. Pass symbol or omit to default to AAPL. Informational only. MCP: get_stocks_data(kind="stats", symbol="NVDA"). 50 sats or $0.05 USDC.
- kind="pro": 100 sats or $0.10 USDC. Use this when an agent must see restatements, amendments, derived Q4, TTM and data-quality flags, or compare two tickers, plus 90-day net Form 4 activity by reporting owner. Pass symbol and optional compare (e.g. compare=AMD). Informational only. MCP: get_stocks_data(kind="pro", symbol="NVDA", compare="AMD"). 100 sats or $0.10 USDC.
- kind="signals": 200 sats or $0.20 USDC. Use this when an agent must know whether revenue, operating cash flow, FCF or margin growth is speeding up or slowing down (QoQ and YoY change-of-change), with a Data BitScore, plus Form 4 signals (cluster open-market purchases and size versus holdings). Feedable on new 10-Q, 10-K and Form 4 filings. Informational only, not investment advice.
Payment: Pay by calling without a credential, paying the Lightning invoice or the USDC amount, then retrying with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or x402_payment. One payment buys one response. Or prepay at /api/v1/credits (Bearer btf_ token) or add ?bt_pass=1 for a 5-minute pass. Details: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_..., from buy_credits). Pays this call from your prepaid sats or USDC balance with no invoice; a failed call is refunded. Balance is non-refundable.

kind.description: Product to fetch. Every kind, its price and when to use it are listed in the tool description.

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

short_pass.description: If true, pay 5x the call price for a 5-minute pass (up to 20 calls to this same endpoint, any parameters). After paying, retry with the same credential or the X-Pass token.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or AAPL. Optional; defaults to AAPL.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
